about: The one type scale of cmux NEXT, native and web (Leo 2026-10-13: unify the font sizes). scripts/cmux-next/gen-type-scale.py writes the CSS tokens (webviews/src/pages/shared/desktop.css) and the Swift ones (CmuxNextDesign/TypeScale.generated.swift) from this file. Sizes are points on macOS and CSS px in the webviews; reading content (transcript, prompt) follows the user's content size and is not a step.
